name: Hirakawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hirakawa city emblem in green and red: a green oval crossed by a light green ring, with a red disc above.
history: Municipal flag of Hirakawa, a city in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Hirakawa city emblem — a green oval crossed by a light green ring, with a red disc above
